def fn(t0, t1, t2, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t0.contiguous()
    v2 = v1.view_as(v1)
    v3 = torch.slice_scatter(v2, t1[:, :, 1:4:1], dim=2, start=1, end=4, step=1)
    v4 = v2.flatten()
    v1.add_(v1.flip(2))
    v5 = v3.view((24,))
    v4[17:19] = v5[17:19]
    return (v3, t0, v1, t2, lst, dct)
